title: USD/JPY holds near 158 despite weak US jobs
summary: USD/JPY traded around 157.9–158.4. The US–Japan rate gap remains wide: Fed 3.75–4.00% versus BoJ 0.75%, the BoJ’s highest since 1995. The BoJ decides on 30 October.
ict: The textbook rate-differential pairing from Month 5 (his 2016 USD/JPY example ran 1,200+ pips). Treat the BoJ meeting as vacuum-block and gap risk; on position ideas keep stops beyond a 40-day low.
